name: aliexpress_search_products

max_price.description: Maximum price filter (wire pr); omit for none

switches.description: Filter switches; bare names or filterCode:<name> values

name: aliexpress_get_product

name: aliexpress_suggest_keywords
description: Get AliExpress keyword suggestions through the recommend MTop endpoint (measured working; the APK suggestion API cannot be invoked through the H5 gateway).

name: aliexpress_get_reviews

filter.description: Review filter (API filter parameter, passed through verbatim)

name: aliexpress_query_sku

name: aliexpress_adjust_sku

name: aliexpress_adjust_pdp
description: Adjust the PDP main block for a selected SKU (mtop.aliexpress.pdp.main.adjust). Request shape is implemented from the app-derived builder, but this endpoint has NOT been live-verified yet (results carry live_verified: false).

name: aliexpress_get_store_groups
description: Fetch an AliExpress store's product groups (mtop.ae.shop.search.product.groupType). Request shape is implemented from the app-derived builder; live acceptance is not yet confirmed (results carry live_verified: false).

name: aliexpress_get_store_module
description: Fetch an AliExpress store page module (ModuleAsyncService). Request shape is implemented from the app-derived builder; live acceptance is not yet confirmed (results carry live_verified: false).

name: aliexpress_search_store_products
description: Search products in an AliExpress store through the captured Android store MTop endpoint. seller_id is required (measured: omitting it fails with FAIL_SYS_BIZPARAM_MISSED).

name: goofish_search_products
description: Search Goofish (Xianyu) products through the APK-derived MTOP search endpoint. Requests are signed by the SecurityGuard runtime bundled with the server; the device identity is generated by the server itself. No configuration is required: on first use the server fetches the few MB of the Goofish app package the signer needs (SecurityGuard libraries, configuration image and certificate; HTTP range requests, SHA-256 verified) and assembles the runtime in its data directory. The signing harness boots in the background when the server starts; a Goofish call made before the boot finishes waits for it (the boot takes several minutes). Sorted or filtered search may be rejected by the server (HTTP 419; cause undetermined). The optional filter arguments (prop_selections = CPV property selections as {property_id: [value_id, ...]}, price_range in "min,max" form, province/city/area, category ids) switch the call to the full filter form.

name: goofish_get_product
description: Fetch normalized Goofish (Xianyu) product details by item id or product URL.

name: goofish_suggest_keywords
description: Get Goofish (Xianyu) keyword suggestions through the APK-derived MTOP suggest endpoint.

name: goofish_get_comments
description: Fetch public comments for a Goofish (Xianyu) product through the APK-derived MTOP comment endpoint. The app's comment.list has no page or cursor mechanism — rows_per_page is the only control; the response's next_page field is informational only and cannot be used to fetch further comments.

rows_per_page.description: Number of comments to request (the app's rowsPerPage)

name: goofish_get_recommendations
description: Fetch recommended items related to a Goofish (Xianyu) product through the APK-derived MTOP recommend endpoint. Continuation is caller-carried: pass the previous result's next_page_state back as page_state to fetch the next page; every result carries the advanced next_page_state and has_more.

page_state.description: Continuation state {page_num, page_size, current_size, history_item_ids} from the previous result's next_page_state

name: goofish_home_feed
description: Fetch the Goofish (Xianyu) home feed through the APK-derived MTOP home endpoint. Continuation is caller-carried: pass the previous result's next_page_state back as page_state (it takes precedence over page); results fetched through the state flow carry the advanced next_page_state.

page_state.description: Continuation state {page_number, last_response_count, client_recycle_params} from the previous result's next_page_state

name: goofish_get_similar_items
description: Fetch items similar to a Goofish (Xianyu) product (search.spusimilar.itemlist). conditions is the caller-supplied conditions object (in the app it is built from the search response's server-issued spuId; the detail response carries no spu identifier). Continuation: pass page_no from the previous result's next_page_state. NOT live-verified: the one measured attempt was rejected by the server-side app-version gate FAIL_BIZ_SERVER_NEED_UPGRADE_MSG2, so a live call may return that business error instead of data.

name: goofish_get_category_guide
description: Fetch a Goofish (Xianyu) category guide tree through the APK-derived MTOP category endpoint. name optionally selects a guide by name.

name: goofish_get_rate_list
description: Fetch the seller evaluations (rate list) for one Goofish (Xianyu) item through the APK-derived MTOP rate endpoint. rated_uid is the rated seller's user id.

name: goofish_get_user_headinfo
description: Fetch a Goofish (Xianyu) user's header info through the APK-derived MTOP headinfo endpoint. NOT live-verified: the request shape is fixed by the app's typed classes, but no in-app caller was found, so reachability is unconfirmed.

name: goofish_get_seller_items
description: Fetch Goofish (Xianyu) publish.items. NOTE: the endpoint has no parameter identifying another user — its confirmed use is selecting one's own items; this is NOT another seller's public listing.

name: goofish_get_city_feed
description: Fetch the Goofish (Xianyu) same-city feed (local.home / local.home.feeds). data_source_id and version are caller-supplied (they are delivered to the app by its page configuration). feeds_api=true selects the feeds variant, which is NOT live-verified.

name: goofish_get_city_nearby
description: Fetch Goofish (Xianyu) nearby corner info (local.near.by.corner.info). NOT live-verified. Coordinates are caller-supplied strings, never invented.

name: goofish_get_fishpond_list
description: List Goofish (Xianyu) fishponds (鱼塘). NOT live-verified (the gateway registration record notes this API may not be registered).

name: goofish_get_fishpond_info
description: Fetch one Goofish (Xianyu) fishpond's detail (fishpool.id). NOT live-verified.

name: goofish_get_fishpond_comments
description: Fetch a Goofish (Xianyu) fishpond's public posts/comments (fishpool.comment.list). NOT live-verified. Coordinates are caller-supplied and omitted when absent.

name: goofish_get_video_play
description: Fetch Goofish (Xianyu) video play info (video.play) for a video id. NOT live-verified.

name: goofish_get_video_play_from_feed_card
description: Fetch Goofish (Xianyu) video play info from a normalized feed card (a card object as returned by the feed/search parsers, carrying video_id/has_video). Cards without a confirmed video, or with a mismatched item_id, are refused before sending. NOT live-verified.

name: goofish_get_fun_comments
description: Fetch Goofish (Xianyu) fun/explore comments (fun.general.comment.list). Cursor paging: pass the previous response's last_cursor as begin_cursor. NOT live-verified.

name: mercari_search_products
description: Search Mercari Japan products through the public web Connect-RPC JSON endpoint. Login-free: requests are authorized with a locally generated DPoP proof, no account or token needed. Each item carries is_auction and, for auction listings, an auction object (highest_bid is the current bid, not a buy-now price; also initial_price, total_bids, bid_deadline). Set exclude_auction to drop auction listings from the results.

sort.description: Sort name; in addition to the usual values, price_without_time_filter / price_asc_without_time_filter / price_desc_without_time_filter (and their sort_/lowest_/highest_ spellings) select SORT_PRICE_WITHOUT_TIME_FILTER

attributes.description: Raw Mercari attribute filter objects, passed through verbatim

name: mercari_get_product
description: Fetch normalized Mercari item detail by item id or item URL through the APK-derived JSON endpoint. Mercari Shops products (item_type beyond, /shops/product/ URLs) are fetched from the Shops endpoint and normalized to the same shape, with item_type beyond and the shop in seller/shop. The item carries is_auction and, for auction listings, an auction object (highest_bid, initial_price, total_bids, expected_end_time, state).

name: mercari_search_seller_products
description: List a seller's Mercari items through the APK-derived items/get_items JSON endpoint. Items carry is_auction and an auction object for auction listings.

name: mercari_suggest_keywords
description: Fetch Mercari autocomplete keyword/seller suggestions through the APK-derived BFF endpoint.

name: mercari_search_brands
description: Search Mercari brand IDs for use with mercari_search_products brand_ids.

name: mercari_search_categories
description: Search Mercari category IDs for use with mercari_search_products category_ids.

name: mercari_get_reviews
description: Get seller reviews/ratings for a Mercari seller. Returns rating summary (good/normal/bad counts, star rating) and individual review messages. Note: the endpoint ignores pagination (verified live — page 2 returns page 1), so page > 1 is rejected with an explicit error rather than silently repeating the first page; the real continuation mechanism is undetermined.

seller_id.description: Seller's numeric user ID (from search results sellerId or item detail seller.id)

name: yflea_search_products
description: Search Yahoo Flea Market (Yahoo!フリマ / PayPayフリマ) products. Uses anonymous __NEXT_DATA__ SSR from paypayfleamarket.yahoo.co.jp. No login needed.

sort.description: default | price_asc | price_desc | newest (aliases: lowest_price, highest_price, new, relevance, ranking)

name: yflea_get_product
description: Fetch Yahoo Flea Market item detail by item ID or URL. Returns full item data. Uses anonymous __NEXT_DATA__ SSR, no login needed.

name: yflea_get_reviews
description: Get seller reviews/ratings for a Yahoo Flea Market seller. Returns rating summary and individual reviews. No login needed.

seller_id.description: Seller ID (from item detail or search results)

name: rakuma_search_products
description: Search Rakuten Rakuma (楽天ラクマ) products through fril.jp. Uses anonymous Rakuten Analytics data. No login needed. 40 items/page.

sort.description: default | price_asc | price_desc | newest | likes (aliases: lowest_price, highest_price, new, popular, relevance)

name: rakuma_get_product
description: Fetch Rakuma item detail by item hash or URL. Returns item data from schema.org JSON-LD Product structured data including seller_hash for use with rakuma_get_reviews. No login needed.

name: rakuma_get_reviews
description: Get seller reviews/ratings for a Rakuma seller. Returns aggregate rating and individual reviews. The seller_hash (32-char hex) is available from rakuma_get_product item detail (seller.seller_hash field). Reviews are sliced client-side from the shop page's full review list, so page/limit page through that list.

seller_hash.description: 32-char hex seller hash from item detail (seller.seller_hash)

name: yauction_search_products
description: Search Yahoo Auctions Japan (ヤフオク) products via the official app API (anonymous, appid). Supports open and closed (落札済み) auctions. sort vocabulary: price_asc | price_desc | bids | bids_asc | end_time | end_time_desc | newest | total_price_asc | total_price_desc | watch_count | featured | start_price_asc | start_price_desc; literal API values (e.g. +TOTAL_PRICE) are also accepted for the matching status. seller_type is a comma-joined list of AUC_STORE / AUCTION / FLEAMARKET; prefecture_code takes comma-joined Prefecture values (e.g. TOKYO,OSAKA). conditions (raw ItemCondition ids, comma-joined) takes precedence over condition, and submit_type (ALL / AUCTION / FIXED) over buynow_only.

shp_spec.description: Spec tokens, space-joined, passed through verbatim

name: yauction_get_product
description: Fetch Yahoo Auctions Japan item detail by auction ID or item URL via the official app API (anonymous, appid), no login needed.

name: yauction_get_statistics
description: Get closed-auction price statistics for a Yahoo Auctions Japan catalog id (search/items/statistics, hm1 variant): totals, the last closed item, and per-day count/avg/max/min. conditions takes ItemCondition ids (a single value is recommended until the multi-value joining form is live-confirmed).

name: yauction_get_statistics_closed
description: Get closed-auction price statistics (yne variant, itemState=closed fixed) with the additional shp_spec / seller_type filters. Same result shape as yauction_get_statistics.

name: yauction_get_seller_profile
description: Get a Yahoo Auctions Japan seller's profile (user/v2 profile): display name, icon, store flags, eKYC/speed-shipping flags and the ratings summary.

name: yauction_get_store_profile
description: Get a Yahoo Auctions Japan store seller's store profile (user/v1 store-profile): announcement text and banners. Non-store sellers may legitimately error here.

name: yauction_get_reviews
description: Get seller reviews/ratings for a Yahoo Auctions Japan seller. Returns individual reviews parsed from the seller rating page plus a ratings_summary (enriched from the seller profile API when available).

name: yauction_suggest_keywords
description: Get Yahoo Auctions Japan keyword suggestions (with category candidates) via the official app API (anonymous, appid).

keyword.description: Partial keyword to suggest completions for

name: rakuten_search_products
description: Search Rakuten Ichiba products through the Rakuten app's guest BFF (dynamic/search/v1). No login or API key. Result product_id is "{shop_id}_{item_id}" and feeds rakuten_get_product / rakuten_get_reviews. sort is one of the app's sorts: the standard form (relevancy, price_low_to_high_all, price_high_to_low_all, newest, review_count_all, review_score_all, price_plus_shippingfee_low_to_high_all, price_plus_shippingfee_high_to_low_all) or the highRelevancy form without the _all suffix (price_low_to_high, price_high_to_low, review_count, review_score, and the two shipping-inclusive forms); the value passes through to the BFF.

filters.description: Comma-joined flag filters (free_shipping, out_of_stock, super_deal, subscription, group_distribution, or server-distributed filter values)

region.description: Prefecture id (48 = overseas, pairs with country)

modules.description: Response modules; empty = the app's default set

name: rakuten_get_product
description: Fetch Rakuten Ichiba product detail through the app's guest BFF (itemscreen/get/v16). Identify the item by shop_id+item_id (or the search result's product "{shop_id}_{item_id}"), or by item_code, shop_id+manage_number, or item_url. The endpoint answers HTTP 207 for partial success; the tool reports ok from the core item data.

product.description: "{shop_id}_{item_id}" from search results, or an item URL

name: rakuten_get_reviews
description: Fetch Rakuten Ichiba product reviews through the app's guest BFF (review/list/v3). sort: -regtime (newest) | -evaluation | -judgment. sex: 0 = male, 1 = female. hits is capped at 30 by the server.

name: rakuten_suggest_keywords
description: Get Rakuten Ichiba keyword suggestions through the app's guest BFF (search/suggest): keyword completions and genre candidates for a partial keyword. No login.

name: rakuten_search_products_aggregated
description: Search Rakuten Ichiba in the app's product-aggregated form (product/search/v1): results are grouped by product rather than by shop listing. No login.

product_id.description: Product id hash from a previous aggregated search

name: rakuten_get_genre_tree
description: Fetch a Rakuten Ichiba genre subtree (genre/search/v1): the genre itself plus, per the include flags, its children, siblings, tag groups and tags. No login.

name: rakuten_get_variant_details
description: Fetch per-variant details for a Rakuten Ichiba item (variantdetails/get/v5): price, inventory and delivery captions for one variant. The state parameters (variant_id, is_available_for_sale, prices, inventory, is_subscription_eligible, delivery_caption_variant) are carried over from rakuten_get_product's response (its variants entries) — pass them from there. No login.

delivery_caption_variant.description: One delivery-caption variant object from the detail response

name: qoo10_search_products
description: Search Qoo10 Japan products through the Qoo10 app's mobile API (GetMoveSearchData). No login. sort: 0 ranking, 1 best-selling, 2 newest, 3 price ascending, 4 price descending, 5 review score, 6 review count. Brand / shipping-from / color / attribute codes come from the service's filter info. Note: the app user agent carries a device-derived token that cannot be reproduced off-device; this client sends a format-preserving placeholder token in its place, which the service accepted in live verification. The service requires Japan-side access in practice.

name: qoo10_get_product
description: Fetch Qoo10 Japan product detail by GD_NO (goods code) or product URL. Qoo10 has no native detail API; this reproduces the app's WebView product page request and extracts the title, price and images from the returned page. Requires Japan-side access in practice (see qoo10_search_products).

name: qoo10_get_search_filters
description: Get the Qoo10 Japan search filter information for a keyword (GetMoveSearchFilterInfo — the data the app's filter popup is built from): the brand, colour, price-band, category, shipping-from, review-score and attribute codes that qoo10_search_products accepts as filter values in this keyword's context. Optionally pass the category code or already-selected brand codes to scope the context. No login. Requires Japan-side access in practice (see qoo10_search_products).

keyword.description: Search keyword the filters apply to

name: qoo10_suggest_keywords
description: Get Qoo10 Japan keyword suggestions through the Qoo10 app's mobile API (GetMoveAutoKeywordSearch). No login. Requires Japan-side access in practice (see qoo10_search_products).

name: yshopping_search_products
description: Search Yahoo! Shopping Japan products through the Yahoo! Shopping app's native API (searchList/v4). No login; the app's built-in appid is used. order is one of: Recommend, Price, TotalPrice, ReviewCount, ReviewScoreAverage, DiscountRate, CatalogReleaseDate, RegistrationDate, GoodDelivery (asc applies mainly to Price / TotalPrice). Result product_id is "{storeId}_{itemCode}" and feeds yshopping_get_product and yshopping_get_reviews.

name: yshopping_get_product
description: Fetch Yahoo! Shopping Japan product detail through the app's native API (item-detail/app/v2). product is the search result's product_id ("{storeId}_{itemCode}") or a store product URL. Detail images are returned as image_ids (the API hands out ids, not URLs); the main image URL is in image.

name: yshopping_get_reviews
description: Fetch Yahoo! Shopping Japan product reviews. The app's native API has no review-list endpoint; the app itself shows reviews by opening the review page (shopping.yahoo.co.jp/review/item/list) in a WebView, and this tool reads reviews from that page's server-rendered data and, for anything beyond the first 20, a non-default sort, or a filter, from the continuation endpoint the page's own SPA uses. product is the search result's product_id ("{storeId}_{itemCode}") or a store product URL. offset is the zero-based index of the first review to return (page through results with offset + count, or the returned next_offset). sort is one of the page's own sort orders: lengthDesc (default, おすすめ順), ratingDesc (評価の高い順), referenceCountDesc (いいねの多い順), postedTimeDesc (新着順), pickUp. rating and sub_review_id apply the page's own review filters (both live-verified). Returns the rating summary (total, average, per-star counts), the reviews, next_offset, and subReviewSummaries — the item's aspect summaries whose id values are what sub_review_id takes.

offset.description: Zero-based index of the first review to return

rating.description: Only reviews with this star rating (the review page's rating filter)

sub_review_id.description: Only reviews that rated this aspect; an id from the item's aspect summaries (subReviewSummaries)

name: yshopping_suggest_keywords
description: Get Yahoo! Shopping Japan keyword suggestions through the suggest endpoint the app uses (suggest-shop.yahooapis.jp, appid built in). Returns keyword completions plus, with detailed (default), category candidates and direct store links. No login.

detailed.description: Also return category and store suggestions

name: amazon_search_products
description: Search Amazon.co.jp products by reproducing the Amazon Shopping app's WebView requests (app-format user agent and the app's pre-navigation cookies; no browser engine). sort (the web s parameter): relevancerank, price-asc-rank, price-desc-rank, review-rank, date-desc-rank. Refinements use Amazon's web facet vocabulary, passed through as the app does: department (i:), category_node (n:), price band (p_36), prime_only (p_85), in_stock_only, min_rating (p_72), brand (p_89), seller_id (me), plus raw rh entries. Note: Amazon serves these pages only to Japan-side access in practice.

asin.description: ASIN to search for directly (field-keywords=ASIN form); takes the place of the keyword search

name: amazon_get_product
description: Fetch Amazon.co.jp product detail by ASIN or product URL, reproducing the app's WebView request (see amazon_search_products). Extracts title, price, main image, rating and review count from the product page. Requires Japan-side access in practice.

name: amazon_suggest_keywords
description: Get Amazon.co.jp keyword suggestions through the completion endpoint the Amazon Shopping app uses. No login. Requires Japan-side access in practice (see amazon_search_products). Note: Amazon product reviews are not exposed — the review pages sit behind a sign-in wall (verified), so no review tool exists.

name: shopping_list_sources
description: List APK-derived endpoints and runtime data sources currently supported by Shopping_MCP.
